nodes.speaker: orrin
nodes.text: Evening, courier.[pause=350] The last ferry waits for [color=gold]one more passenger[/color].[page]Have you brought the letter for the lighthouse?

nodes.speaker: mira
nodes.text: Right here![pause=250] But the address says [font=soft][color=cyan]beyond the sleeping sea[/color][/font]. Is that a real place?

nodes.speaker: orrin
nodes.text: Only on quiet nights. Shall we take the ferry, or hear the old story first?

nodes.speaker: orrin
nodes.text: [speed=65]Long ago,[pause=650] a keeper hung a lantern above these waters.[speed=25] Its light still guides every boat home.

nodes.speaker: mira
nodes.text: Then we had better keep that light burning. [color=gold]Come on![/color]

nodes.speaker: orrin
nodes.text: All aboard, courier. The sea has been expecting you.

nodes.speaker: radio
nodes.text: [font=soft][color=cyan]...signal found...[pause=700] LANTERN STATION...[pause=450] can anyone hear me?[/color][/font]

nodes.speaker: mira
nodes.text: I hear you! Your words sound a little different through this old radio.

nodes.speaker: radio
nodes.text: [font=soft][color=cyan][speed=45]The fog is thick tonight.[pause=600] Follow the [color=gold]three warm lights[/color], then turn toward home.[/color][/font]

nodes.speaker: mira
nodes.text: Three lights. I will remember. [color=gold]Thank you, whoever you are.[/color]

nodes.speaker: orrin
nodes.text: The bridge is hidden in the mist. A compass might help. What would you like to do?

nodes.speaker: orrin
nodes.text: Of course. [color=gold]You received a compass![/color][pause=500] The choices will remember it when we talk again.

nodes.speaker: mira
nodes.text: The needle points through the fog.[pause=400] There is the bridge! A little kindness goes a long way.

nodes.speaker: orrin
nodes.text: There is always another boat tomorrow. Rest here as long as you need.
